title: The Phantom — character emblem inverse (Ink Protocol vector master)
usage: Character art on black: boot, dark posters, inverse hero. ~1.8 MB of drawn detail; for screens use the PNGs beside it. Not the logo — the shield is (ADR-0015).
rules: Clear space: a quarter of the emblem width on every side.
Never recolour the figure, add a second character, stretch it, or place it over busy art.
Never use it as the logo or merge it with the shield; with both on one surface, the shield sits in the chrome and the Phantom is the art.
